headline_hook: Stolen API Tokens Fuel a Shadow Market While CEOs Demand Radical Transparency
preview_topics: the underground API token relay market
a TTS model small enough for your laptop

pick_of_the_day.thesis: The relay market isn't just a security curiosity — it's a mature, price-optimized economy that reveals how fundamentally broken the LLM access model is when a single leaked key can be arbitraged across thousands of fraudulent requests before anyone notices.

model_literacy.concept: API Key Scoping and Least-Privilege Access
model_literacy.relevance: The relay market thrives because most LLM API keys are over-privileged — understanding key scoping, usage caps, and rotation policies is the first line of defense against your keys ending up resold in a commodity fraud economy.

items.title: Inside the Relay Market Where Your Leaked API Keys Get Resold
items.angle: Simon Willison maps the underground economy turning stolen LLM tokens into a commodity — builders need to understand where their leaked keys actually end up
items.key_fact: Relay markets offer tiered pricing for stolen API access, with operators running thousands of requests per key before detection

items.title: Hugging Face CEO Demands 'Radical Transparency' After OpenAI's Rogue Agent Breach
